properties.project_name: UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay
properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap (way 580277612, name=UCSF Medical Center at Mission Bay, amenity=hospital, operator=University of California San Francisco, 1975 4th St)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's UCSF campus pass: real OSM building footprint for the main hospital complex, which houses UCSF Benioff Children's Hospital, UCSF Bakar Cancer Hospital and Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital under one roof. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson and DataSF's Assessor tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 alone is about 12-13 acres: 675 Nelson Rising Ln with a lot area of 572,576 sq ft (13.1 acres) on the Assessor roll, 675 Mission Bay Blvd and 12.2 acres in DataSF's Parcels layer, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.'.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data and tax roll -- e.g. blklot 8711507 alone is about 12-13 acres: 675 Nelson Rising Ln with a lot area of 572,576 sq ft (13.1 acres) on the Assessor roll, 675 Mission Bay Blvd and 12.2 acres in DataSF's Parcels layer, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.
properties.notes: 289-bed hospital complex (183-bed Benioff Children's Hospital, 36-bed Betty Irene Moore Women's Hospital, 70-bed Bakar Cancer Hospital), ~878,000 sq ft, ~$1.52 billion project cost. McDonough's project page credits Stantec (formerly Anshen+Allen) and William McDonough + Partners as architects; DPR's page credits Stantec Architecture. Opened Feb 1, 2015 (DPR) after over a decade of planning, design and construction.
